### Chapter 12: Portfolio Constraints {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| label: sol-12-setup
#| include: false
source("R/_common.R")
library(tidypm)
R  <- as_xts_pm(sim_class_returns_monthly, date, class, return)
rf <- sim_riskfree_monthly$return
Re <- R - rf
S  <- stats::cov(Re); mu <- colMeans(Re); N <- ncol(Re)
p_vol <- function(w) sqrt(as.numeric(t(w) %*% S %*% w) * 12)
p_ret <- function(w) sum(mu * w) * 12
p_sr  <- function(w) p_ret(w) / p_vol(w)

# The chapter's helpers, repeated so that this fragment runs on its own.
weights_of <- function(spec, method = "ROI", ...) {
  a <- names(spec$assets)
  stopifnot(all(a %in% colnames(Re)))
  w <- extractWeights(optimize.portfolio(Re[, a], spec, optimize_method = method, ...))
  stopifnot(!is.null(w), !anyNA(w), all(a %in% names(w)))
  out <- setNames(numeric(ncol(Re)), colnames(Re)); out[a] <- w[a]
  out
}
min_var  <- function(spec) weights_of(spec |> add.objective(type = "risk", name = "var"))
tangency <- function(spec) weights_of(spec |>
  add.objective(type = "return", name = "mean") |>
  add.objective(type = "risk",   name = "StdDev"), maxSR = TRUE)
base_spec <- portfolio.spec(assets = colnames(Re)) |>
  add.constraint(type = "full_investment") |>
  add.constraint(type = "long_only")
w_gmv <- min_var(base_spec); w_tan <- tangency(base_spec)

group_of <- function(a) dplyr::case_when(
  grepl("_equity$", a) ~ "equity", grepl("_government$", a) ~ "government",
  grepl("_credit$", a) ~ "credit", TRUE ~ "commodity")
grp   <- split(seq_len(N), group_of(colnames(Re)))
m_min <- c(commodity = 0.00, credit = 0.00, equity = 0.40, government = 0.10)
m_max <- c(commodity = 0.15, credit = 0.40, equity = 0.60, government = 1.00)
stopifnot(identical(names(grp), names(m_min)), identical(names(grp), names(m_max)))
floor_ann <- 0.06

build <- function(m_min, m_max, cap, floor, assets = colnames(Re)) {
  g <- split(seq_along(assets), group_of(assets))
  stopifnot(all(names(m_min)[m_min > 0] %in% names(g)))
  portfolio.spec(assets = assets) |>
    add.constraint(type = "full_investment") |>
    add.constraint(type = "box", min = 0, max = cap) |>
    add.constraint(type = "group", groups = g,
                   group_min = unname(m_min[names(g)]), group_max = unname(m_max[names(g)])) |>
    add.constraint(type = "return", return_target = floor / 12)
}
largest8 <- function(w) names(sort(w, decreasing = TRUE))[1:8]   # the screen of the chapter
tighten <- list(
  `equity >= 40%`     = \(m1, m2, cap, fl) { m1["equity"] <- m1["equity"] + 0.01;         build(m1, m2, cap, fl) },
  `equity <= 60%`     = \(m1, m2, cap, fl) { m2["equity"] <- m2["equity"] - 0.01;         build(m1, m2, cap, fl) },
  `government >= 10%` = \(m1, m2, cap, fl) { m1["government"] <- m1["government"] + 0.01; build(m1, m2, cap, fl) },
  `credit <= 40%`     = \(m1, m2, cap, fl) { m2["credit"] <- m2["credit"] - 0.01;         build(m1, m2, cap, fl) },
  `commodity <= 15%`  = \(m1, m2, cap, fl) { m2["commodity"] <- m2["commodity"] - 0.01;   build(m1, m2, cap, fl) },
  `no series > cap`   = \(m1, m2, cap, fl) build(m1, m2, cap - 0.01, fl),
  `return >= 6%`      = \(m1, m2, cap, fl) build(m1, m2, cap, fl + 0.01))
shadow_of <- function(cap, w_mv, w_tn) lapply(names(tighten), function(nm) {
  s <- tighten[[nm]](m_min, m_max, cap, floor_ann)
  tibble::tibble(line = nm, d_vol_mv = 100 * (p_vol(min_var(s)) - p_vol(w_mv)),
                 d_sr_tan = p_sr(tangency(s)) - p_sr(w_tn))
}) |> dplyr::bind_rows()
```

#### Exercise 1

The 25% cap sits on the same lines with one number changed. The floor still
has to be checked before it is imposed, because a cap that forces money out of
`US_government` raises the minimum-variance return and may make the floor
slack.

```{r}
#| label: sol-12-ex1
spec25   <- build(m_min, m_max, 0.25, floor_ann)
w_mv25_0 <- min_var(portfolio.spec(assets = colnames(Re)) |>
  add.constraint(type = "full_investment") |> add.constraint(type = "box", min = 0, max = 0.25) |>
  add.constraint(type = "group", groups = grp, group_min = unname(m_min[names(grp)]),
                 group_max = unname(m_max[names(grp)])))
floor_binds <- p_ret(w_mv25_0) < floor_ann
w_mv25 <- if (floor_binds) min_var(spec25) else w_mv25_0
w_tn25 <- tangency(spec25)
w_tn35 <- tangency(build(m_min, m_max, 0.35, floor_ann))        # the chapter's mandate
sh25   <- shadow_of(0.25, w_mv25, w_tn25)
held25 <- c(min_variance = sum(w_mv25 > 1e-6), tangency = sum(w_tn25 > 1e-6))
c(return_without_floor = p_ret(w_mv25_0), floor_binds = floor_binds,
  vol_mv = p_vol(w_mv25), sharpe_tan_25 = p_sr(w_tn25), sharpe_tan_35 = p_sr(w_tn35))
sh25 |> dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(-line, ~ round(.x, 4)))
held25
```

With the cap at 25%, the minimum-variance portfolio under the class limits
earns `r sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * p_ret(w_mv25_0))` before any floor, so the
floor `r if (floor_binds) "still binds" else "is slack and is left out"`. The
lines that bind on the minimum-variance objective are
`r paste(sh25$line[abs(sh25$d_vol_mv) > 1e-6], collapse = "; ")`, and the
equity floor costs
`r sprintf("%.3f", abs(sh25$d_vol_mv[sh25$line == "equity >= 40%"]))` percentage
points of volatility per point of tightening, against
`r sprintf("%.3f", abs(sh25$d_vol_mv[sh25$line == "no series > cap"]))` for the
cap itself. The tangency's Sharpe ratio is `r sprintf("%.3f", p_sr(w_tn25))`,
`r if (p_sr(w_tn25) < p_sr(w_tn35)) "below" else "above"` the
`r sprintf("%.3f", p_sr(w_tn35))` of the 35%-cap mandate, because the tighter
cap takes more from the series the optimizer wanted most.

The eighth line is the one the table cannot show, because the solver does not
read it. The two answers hold `r held25[["min_variance"]]` and
`r held25[["tangency"]]` positions against a limit of eight, so at this cap the
screen of the chapter is needed on both objectives.

```{r}
#| label: sol-12-ex1-screen
stopifnot(floor_binds, all(held25 > 8))
w_mv25_8 <- min_var(build(m_min, m_max, 0.25, floor_ann, assets = largest8(w_mv25)))
w_tn25_8 <- tangency(build(m_min, m_max, 0.25, floor_ann, assets = largest8(w_tn25)))
stopifnot(sum(w_mv25_8 > 1e-6) <= 8, sum(w_tn25_8 > 1e-6) <= 8, p_ret(w_tn25_8) >= floor_ann)
c(d_vol_mv = 100 * (p_vol(w_mv25_8) - p_vol(w_mv25)), d_sr_tan = p_sr(w_tn25_8) - p_sr(w_tn25))
```

Holding eight costs
`r sprintf("%.3f", 100 * (p_vol(w_mv25_8) - p_vol(w_mv25)))` percentage points
of volatility on the minimum-variance portfolio and
`r sprintf("%.5f", p_sr(w_tn25) - p_sr(w_tn25_8))` of Sharpe ratio on the
tangency, whose smallest position was
`r sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * min(w_tn25[w_tn25 > 1e-6]))` of the portfolio.

#### Exercise 2

With both bounds active, the first-order condition is
$\boldsymbol{\Sigma}\boldsymbol{w} = \lambda_0\boldsymbol{\iota} + \boldsymbol{\delta} - \boldsymbol{\lambda}$
with $\delta_i > 0$ only where $w_i = 0$ and $\lambda_i > 0$ only where
$w_i = \bar{w}_i$. Any asset strictly inside its bounds has both multipliers
zero, which identifies $\lambda_0$.

```{r}
#| label: sol-12-ex2
bmax <- setNames(rep(0.25, N), colnames(Re)); bmax["GLOBAL_commodity"] <- 0.10
w_box <- min_var(base_spec |> add.constraint(type = "box", min = 0, max = bmax))
Sw    <- as.numeric(S %*% w_box)
at_zero <- w_box < 1e-6; at_cap <- abs(w_box - bmax) < 1e-6; interior <- !at_zero & !at_cap
stopifnot(any(interior), diff(range(Sw[interior])) < 1e-8)
lambda0 <- mean(Sw[interior])
delta   <- ifelse(at_zero, Sw - lambda0, 0)
lambda  <- ifelse(at_cap,  lambda0 - Sw, 0)
stopifnot(all(delta >= -1e-8), all(lambda >= -1e-8))
one <- rep(1, N)
S_tilde <- S - (outer(delta, one) + outer(one, delta)) + (outer(lambda, one) + outer(one, lambda))
w_jm <- as.numeric(solve(S_tilde, one)); w_jm <- w_jm / sum(w_jm)
c(interior = sum(interior), at_cap = sum(at_cap), at_zero = sum(at_zero),
  max_abs_difference = max(abs(w_jm - w_box)))
```

The unconstrained portfolio on the modified matrix reproduces the capped
solution to `r sprintf("%.0e", max(abs(w_jm - w_box)))`. The signs are the
substance: the $\lambda$ terms *add* to the covariances of the capped series,
which is the constraint telling the estimator that those series are less
diversifying than the sample says, exactly as the $\delta$ terms subtract from
the covariances of the excluded ones.

#### Exercise 3

A second grouping cannot be a second `group` line, so the regional cap goes in
through `factor_exposure_constraint()` with an indicator matrix.

```{r}
#| label: sol-12-ex3
region   <- sub("_.*$", "", colnames(Re))
B_region <- sapply(sort(unique(region)), function(r) as.numeric(region == r))
rownames(B_region) <- colnames(Re)
mandate  <- build(m_min, m_max, 0.35, floor_ann)
regional <- mandate |> add.constraint(type = "factor_exposure", B = B_region,
                                      lower = rep(0, ncol(B_region)), upper = rep(0.40, ncol(B_region)))
w_mv_r <- min_var(regional); w_tn_r <- tangency(regional)
w_mv_m <- min_var(mandate);  w_tn_m <- tangency(mandate)
exposure <- function(w) setNames(as.numeric(t(B_region) %*% w), colnames(B_region))
rbind(min_variance_before = exposure(w_mv_m), min_variance_after = exposure(w_mv_r),
      tangency_before = exposure(w_tn_m), tangency_after = exposure(w_tn_r)) |> round(3)
sh35 <- shadow_of(0.35, w_mv_m, w_tn_m)                          # the chapter's shadow prices
other  <- colnames(B_region) != "US"                             # the cap binds on US, and only there
stopifnot(abs(exposure(w_mv_r)[["US"]] - 0.40) < 1e-6, all(exposure(w_mv_r)[other] < 0.40 - 1e-6),
          abs(exposure(w_tn_r)[["US"]] - 0.40) < 1e-6, all(exposure(w_tn_r)[other] < 0.40 - 1e-6))
best_sr <- names(which.max(mu / sqrt(diag(S)))); least_vol <- names(which.min(diag(S)))
stopifnot(grepl("^US_", best_sr), grepl("^US_", least_vol), p_sr(w_tn_r) < p_sr(w_tn_m))
held_r <- c(min_variance = sum(w_mv_r > 1e-6), tangency = sum(w_tn_r > 1e-6))
c(sharpe_before = p_sr(w_tn_m), sharpe_after = p_sr(w_tn_r),
  largest_class_line = max(abs(sh35$d_sr_tan)), vol_mv_before = p_vol(w_mv_m), vol_mv_after = p_vol(w_mv_r))
```

Before the regional line the tangency portfolio had
`r sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * exposure(w_tn_m)[["US"]])` in US series, so the
40% cap binds on `US` for both objectives
(`r sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * exposure(w_tn_r)[["US"]])` after) and on no other
region. The Sharpe ratio moves from `r sprintf("%.3f", p_sr(w_tn_m))` to
`r sprintf("%.3f", p_sr(w_tn_r))`, a cost
`r sprintf("%.0f", (p_sr(w_tn_m) - p_sr(w_tn_r)) / max(abs(sh35$d_sr_tan)))`
times the largest one-point shadow price of any asset-class line in the
chapter, because the US block holds both the best in-sample Sharpe ratio of
the universe, `r best_sr`, and its least volatile series, `r least_vol`. The
regional answers hold `r held_r[["min_variance"]]` and
`r held_r[["tangency"]]` positions, so the eighth line of the mandate fails on
both and the screen of the chapter has to follow before either is a mandate
portfolio.

#### Exercise 4

The floor $\boldsymbol{w}'\boldsymbol{w} \le 1 - d$ is convex, so the exact
answer is one CVXR call per floor; the search is placed on the same chart.

```{r}
#| label: sol-12-ex4
#| warning: false
#| message: false
w_var <- CVXR::Variable(N)
exact_floor <- function(d) {
  CVXR::psolve(CVXR::Problem(CVXR::Minimize(CVXR::quad_form(w_var, S)),
    list(CVXR::sum_entries(w_var) == 1, w_var >= 0, CVXR::sum_squares(w_var) <= 1 - d)),
    solver = "CLARABEL")
  w <- pmax(as.numeric(CVXR::value(w_var)), 0); w / sum(w)
}
floors <- c(0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8)
exact  <- tibble::tibble(floor = floors, vol = vapply(floors, \(d) p_vol(exact_floor(d)), numeric(1)),
                         kind = "exact, CVXR")
stopifnot(all(diff(exact$vol) > 0), all(diff(diff(exact$vol)) > 0))   # rising, and convex in the floor
set.seed(1602)
utils::capture.output(
  w_de <- weights_of(base_spec |> add.constraint(type = "diversification", div_target = 0.6) |>
                       add.objective(type = "risk", name = "var"),
                     method = "DEoptim", search_size = 2000, itermax = 50, traceDE = 0, trace = FALSE)) |> invisible()
pts <- dplyr::bind_rows(exact, tibble::tibble(floor = diversification(w_de), vol = p_vol(w_de), kind = "DEoptim, target 0.6"))
stopifnot(abs(diversification(w_de) - 0.6) <= 0.05 * 0.6, p_vol(w_de) > exact$vol[2])   # in the band, above the exact
pts
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-sol-12-ex4
#| fig-cap: "Minimum-variance volatility against the diversification floor, solved exactly, with one DEoptim run at a target of 0.6 placed where it landed."
#| echo: false
#| fig-asp: 0.5
ggplot2::ggplot(pts, ggplot2::aes(floor, vol, colour = kind, shape = kind)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(data = dplyr::filter(pts, kind == "exact, CVXR"), linewidth = 0.7) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  scale_colour_tidyaa() +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "diversification floor, 1 - w'w", y = "annualized volatility", colour = NULL, shape = NULL)
```

Volatility rises with the floor, from
`r sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * exact$vol[1])` at 0.5 to
`r sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * exact$vol[4])` at 0.8, and the curve is convex in
the floor because each step forces the portfolio further from the
minimum-variance corner. The search lands at a diversification of
`r sprintf("%.3f", diversification(w_de))`, inside the package's five percent
band around 0.6, at `r sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * p_vol(w_de))` volatility,
`r sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * (p_vol(w_de) / exact$vol[2] - 1))` above the exact
solution at the 0.6 floor. The heuristic honors the constraint and loses on
the objective, which is the trade @sec-13-solvers-application measures.
